issues: ABSTRACT_OBJECT_DRIFT: weapon lane is not sufficiently locked to sword-first behavior.
fixes: Add sword-first anti-drift rules and ban abstract object, mask-like, rounded object, and ceramic reads.

revised_intake.creative_intent: Reproduce the Zenith Blade weapon hero master, focusing on a massive, engineered greatsword with a perfectly straight blade and rigid long silhouette, rendered in forged metal with a restrained crimson seam.

must_have: exactly one manufactured object as the clear subject
visible contour evidence such as edge, rim, bevel, seam, or curvature
material visibly attached to the object, not floating as texture

composition.framing: Centered front-on full vertical framing, no tilt, no side profile, no crop

constraints: Even illumination to highlight form and material
Emphasize the straightness of the blade
color must remain subordinate to material identity
color must follow form then material, never override them
no flat color, always material texture variation
pure white and pure black are forbidden
charcoal black must keep temperature variation, never dead pure black
restrained crimson only in seams, cores, or controlled heat accents
muted earth support only, low saturation material support tones

core_risks: Drift to abstract or texture-only subject
Unwanted material reads (e.g., plastic, ceramic, stone)
Deviation from specified camera angle and framing
material misread as plaster, stone, or glossy plastic
anti_drift_rules: Lock the object read and prevent abstract drift.
Ensure material is clearly forged metal, not ceramic, porcelain, or plastic.
Prevent any texture-only, atmosphere-first, or abstract-first outcomes.
Strictly adhere to centered front-on full vertical framing.
always preserve one clearly readable manufactured object
do not let texture or atmosphere become the subject
keep material identity locked and explicit
form -> material -> color priority is mandatory
do not allow neon, pure white, pure black, or plastic-clean RGB drift
crimson may appear only as restrained seam/core accent when applicable
weapon lane wins over ceramic or mask bias
subject must read as sword first and material second
do not allow ceramic, porcelain, plastic, or rounded industrial object drift
keep blade geometry elongated, straight, and engineered
success_criteria: Clear read of a straight engineered greatsword.
Forged metal material clearly visible and dominant.
Centered front-on full vertical framing maintained.
Restrained crimson seam is the only color accent.
image does not collapse into abstract texture or atmosphere
color feels subtractive and pigment-like, never RGB-clean
shadow mass dominates and color remains materially grounded
image reads immediately as a straight engineered greatsword
blade geometry is explicit and not abstract
material reads as forged metal, steel, titanium, or dark industrial alloy
revised_intake.direction_summary: Reproduce the Zenith Blade greatsword as a hero frame. Focus on a massive, engineered, perfectly straight blade in forged metal with a satin finish. Maintain a centered front-on full vertical framing and a rigid long silhouette. Ensure the sword identity is unmistakable and prevent any abstract or unwanted material reads. Include only a restrained crimson seam.
